opportunities.title: Modern 3-4 Bedroom House Plan
opportunities.description: I’m ready to move from ideas to drawings for a modern, clean-lined home with 3–4 bedrooms. The look I have in mind is simple and contemporary rather than ornate, with an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living area acting as the centre of daily life. What I need now are complete design documents that will let me discuss permits and construction pricing with local builders. At minimum this includes scaled floor plans, elevations, and a few 3D perspectives so I can visualise massing and materials. If you typically add an electrical or plumbing layout, that’s a bonus I’d be happy to review. AutoCAD, Revit, ArchiCAD, or comparable BIM software are all acceptable as long as the final files are editable and accompanied by PDFs for quick sharing. Please make sure room sizes feel spacious yet efficient, circulation flows logically between private and public zones, and natural light is maximised. Once the first concept set is complete I’ll provide consolidated feedback; two rounds of revisions should be enough to fine-tune the layout before moving on to the polished drawings. When you reply, let me know which software you prefer and share one or two similar projects from your portfolio that show a modern, understated style. I’m eager to start as soon as we agree on a timeline.

opportunities.title: Testimonial Clinic Reel Editor Needed
opportunities.description: I have short doctor- and patient-testimonial clips that need to be turned into polished vertical reels for our clinic’s social channels. You’ll be working with raw interview footage that I’ll provide; your job is to shape each story into a 30–60 second Instagram- and Facebook-ready reel that feels trustworthy, upbeat, and on-brand. What I’m looking for • Clean, engaging cuts that keep the speaker front-and-center • Subtle motion graphics or stock b-roll where it helps illustrate a point (no overwhelming effects) • On-screen captions that follow brand colours and are easy to read without sound • Light background music mixed under the voice, royalty-free only • Final render in 1080 × 1920 MP4 plus a separate .srt caption file I’ll supply logo files, brand fonts, and a style guide so you can stay consistent. If you prefer Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or even CapCut, that’s fine—just let me know your workflow. Please show me one or two vertical testimonial edits you’ve produced recently. I’m starting with a batch of five reels; if we click, there will be a steady stream each month.

opportunities.title: Senior Cloud Engineers Needed for IT Infrastructure and Operations
opportunities.description: We need 2 Experienced Cloud Engineers with 5 + years of related experience to take charge of our Cloud Based infrastructure and day-to-day operations. As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact and grow your expertise to move your career forward. Meaningful Work and Personal Impact: - Manage and support the AWS cloud infrastructure and enterprise platforms that power the program's data ingestion, analytics, and partner-facing applications, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Amazon WorkSpaces, and secure file transfer services. - Collaborate with Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Security, and Web Development teams, and with external healthcare partners, to provide infrastructure solutions and secure data exchange. - Drive continuous improvement by remediating vulnerabilities, keeping platforms current, and automating recurring operational work with proven and emerging technologies such as AI, serverless, and IaC. - Utilize hands-on experience in administering and automating resilient, high-performing systems. What you'll need to succeed: - Bachelor of Science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. - 5+ years of related experience focused on cloud engineering, such as serving as a Cloud Engineer, Cloud Administrator, or DevOps Engineer. - Hands-on experience administering and supporting core AWS services in production, such as EC2, ECS, S3, Route 53, VPC, IAM, Elastic Load Balancing, RDS, and CloudWatch, following least privilege and cloud security best practices. - Foundational networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, SSH/SFTP, and firewall concepts. - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation or similar automation frameworks. - Experience administering or supporting Linux and Windows operating systems in enterprise or production environments. - Proficiency with scripting and programming languages, including Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other applicable languages. - Experience administering enterprise applications hosted on cloud infrastructure, including upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, and availability management. - Experience administering or supporting Active Directory, including user and group management, group policy, and integration with applications and multi-factor authentication services. - Experience with vulnerability and patch management, including remediating scanner findings within defined timelines and deploying updates across servers and virtual desktops. - Experience in a 24/7 production environment, including ticket-based operational support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and change management. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desired Skills and Abilities: - AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate), AWS Certified SysOps Administrator (Associate), or comparable cloud certifications. - Experience administering commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software, including installation, version upgrades, licensing, and vendor support coordination. - Experience administering Amazon WorkSpaces and endpoint protection tools. - Experience with multi-account AWS environments, AWS Organizations, service control policies, and centralized governance models. - Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks, including NIST, CIS benchmarks, or FISMA. - Experience maintaining STIG-hardened machine images and automated image build pipelines. - Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as AWS Systems Manager, PDQ Deploy, or comparable platforms. - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Amazon Kiro, or equivalent organization-approved tools for code generation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure automation. - If you've read all above carefully, tell me what is your favorite color at the very top of your detailed proposal. I'd like to connect with you further then. Please note a few things carefully: - This will be a Permanent Full/Partial Time Remote Job - You'll be paid Monthly Salary via Freelancer.com - We'll discuss salary based on your experience - Preferred Time Zone is USA - Preferred Employees from India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan Share your Resume, a detailed proposal of your understanding of the job nature and your expertise/past experience in relevant skillset.

As a Senior Cloud Engineer, you’ll power innovation to drive mission impact and grow your expertise to move your career forward. Meaningful Work and Personal Impact: - Manage and support the AWS cloud infrastructure and enterprise platforms that power the program's data ingestion, analytics, and partner-facing applications, including Windows Server, Active Directory, Amazon WorkSpaces, and secure file transfer services. - Collaborate with Data Analytics, Data Engineering, Security, and Web Development teams, and with external healthcare partners, to provide infrastructure solutions and secure data exchange. - Drive continuous improvement by remediating vulnerabilities, keeping platforms current, and automating recurring operational work with proven and emerging technologies such as AI, serverless, and IaC. - Utilize hands-on experience in administering and automating resilient, high-performing systems. What you'll need to succeed: - Bachelor of Science, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. - 5+ years of related experience focused on cloud engineering, such as serving as a Cloud Engineer, Cloud Administrator, or DevOps Engineer. - Hands-on experience administering and supporting core AWS services in production, such as EC2, ECS, S3, Route 53, VPC, IAM, Elastic Load Balancing, RDS, and CloudWatch, following least privilege and cloud security best practices. - Foundational networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, TLS, SSH/SFTP, and firewall concepts. - Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code using AWS CloudFormation or similar automation frameworks. - Experience administering or supporting Linux and Windows operating systems in enterprise or production environments. - Proficiency with scripting and programming languages, including Python, Bash, PowerShell, or other applicable languages. - Experience administering enterprise applications hosted on cloud infrastructure, including upgrades, patching, troubleshooting, and availability management. - Experience administering or supporting Active Directory, including user and group management, group policy, and integration with applications and multi-factor authentication services. - Experience with vulnerability and patch management, including remediating scanner findings within defined timelines and deploying updates across servers and virtual desktops. - Experience in a 24/7 production environment, including ticket-based operational support, incident response, root-cause analysis, and change management. - Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical findings and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Desired Skills and Abilities: - AWS certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect (Associate), AWS Certified SysOps Administrator (Associate), or comparable cloud certifications. - Experience administering commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software, including installation, version upgrades, licensing, and vendor support coordination. - Experience administering Amazon WorkSpaces and endpoint protection tools. - Experience with multi-account AWS environments, AWS Organizations, service control policies, and centralized governance models. - Experience with cloud security and compliance frameworks, including NIST, CIS benchmarks, or FISMA. - Experience maintaining STIG-hardened machine images and automated image build pipelines. - Experience with configuration management and automation tools such as AWS Systems Manager, PDQ Deploy, or comparable platforms. - Familiarity with AI-assisted engineering tools such as Claude Code, Amazon Kiro, or equivalent organization-approved tools for code generation, troubleshooting, and infrastructure automation. - If you've read all above carefully, tell me what is your favorite color at the very top of your detailed proposal. I'd like to connect with you further then. Please note a few things carefully: - This will be a Permanent Full/Partial Time Remote Job - You'll be paid Monthly Salary via Freelancer.com - We'll discuss salary based on your experience - Preferred Time Zone is USA - Preferred Employees from India, Nepal, Bangladesh and Pakistan Share your Resume, a detailed proposal of your understanding of the job nature and your expertise/past experience in relevant skillset."

opportunities.title: Tulis Balasan Bubble Chat Ramah
opportunities.description: Saya sedang mengerjakan tugas yang menuntut saya menyiapkan serangkaian balasan bubble chat untuk menghadapi pertanyaan pelanggan. Kebutuhan utamanya sederhana: • Format balasan: bubble chat siap pakai, satu per pesan. • Gaya bahasa: ramah, santai, namun tetap singkat dan langsung ke inti. • Konteks penggunaan: membalas pesan pelanggan di platform chat (mis. WhatsApp, Instagram DM, atau live-chat situs). Saya akan memberikan skenario umum pertanyaan pelanggan (misalnya: tanya harga, cara klaim garansi, hingga permintaan refund). Tugas Anda adalah menulis balasan efektif untuk tiap skenario, lengkap dengan sapaan, inti jawaban, dan ajakan tindakan bila perlu. Pastikan setiap balasan: – Tidak melebihi 2–3 kalimat. – Memakai bahasa Indonesia sehari-hari tanpa slang berlebihan. – Terlihat natural saat ditempel di gelembung chat. Output yang saya harapkan: dokumen teks atau spreadsheet berisi dua kolom (Pertanyaan & Balasan). Jika Anda memiliki ide template tambahan yang relevan, silakan sertakan sebagai bonus. Saya butuh hasil cepat agar dapat segera menyelesaikan tugas presentasi.

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Google Ads Setup
opportunities.description: My current Google Ads account still runs on an old, manually optimised campaign and it’s no longer giving me the foot traffic I need. I want a fresh campaign built from scratch that taps into Google’s latest AI and machine-learning features (e.g. Performance Max, Smart Bidding, broad-match with signals) so I can start attracting more local visitors. The focus is clear: bring people through the door from specific towns and cities around my location. You’ll set the geographic targeting accordingly, craft ad assets that highlight my business, link the location extension, and configure conversion tracking so I can see in-store visit metrics inside Google Ads and Google Analytics. Once the campaign is live and hitting the ground running, your job is done—I don’t need ongoing monthly management, just a solid launch that I can let Google’s automation optimise over time. Deliverables I expect: • Brief audit of the existing account (for context only) • New campaign build using Google AI features, location extensions and call-outs • Precise town/city targeting aligned to my service area • Conversion tracking (store visits, calls, driving-direction clicks) tested and active • One-page hand-off document explaining key settings and how to monitor results If this sounds straightforward for you and you’re comfortable working directly in Google Ads, let’s get started so the new campaign can begin pulling in local customers right away.

I want a fresh campaign built from scratch that taps into Google’s latest AI and machine-learning features (e.g. Performance Max, Smart Bidding, broad-match with signals) so I can start attracting more local visitors. You’ll set the geographic targeting accordingly, craft ad assets that highlight my business, link the location extension, and configure conversion tracking so I can see in-store visit metrics inside Google Ads and Google Analytics. Once the campaign is live and hitting the ground running, your job is done—I don’t need ongoing monthly management, just a solid launch that I can let Google’s automation optimise over time. Deliverables I expect: • Brief audit of the existing account (for context only) • New campaign build using Google AI features, location extensions and call-outs • Precise town/city targeting aligned to my service area • Conversion tracking (store visits, calls, driving-direction clicks) tested and active • One-page hand-off document explaining key settings and how to monitor results If this sounds straightforward for you and you’re comfortable working directly in Google Ads, let’s get started so the new campaign can begin pulling in local customers right away."

opportunities.title: Reels Dinámicos para Cursos Digitales
opportunities.description: Cuento con varios cursos en línea que ya venden bien, pero quiero potenciar las conversiones a través de Reels verticales que enganchen en los primeros segundos y lleven directamente al clic de compra. Busco un editor creativo que domine el formato corto y sea capaz de convertir material crudo —hablados a cámara, grabaciones de pantalla o stock— en piezas de 15-60 s llenas de ritmo, texto persuasivo, música pegadiza y cortes rápidos. El objetivo es uno solo: vender. Por eso necesito hooks potentes, subtítulos quemados en pantalla, efectos de sonido que resalten las frases clave y llamados a la acción claros. Trabajo en español, así que la ortografía en los textos es crucial. Para que sepas exactamente qué entregar, esto es lo que espero en cada Reel: • Video 9:16 en 1080 × 1920, máximo 60 s • Corrección de color y audio básica • Texto animado y subtítulos integrados • Archivo final .mp4 optimizado para Instagram y TikTok • Proyecto editable (Premiere, Final Cut, After Effects o CapCut) Si disfrutas experimentando con transiciones, motion graphics ligeros y música libre de derechos que mantenga el ritmo, me encantará ver tu reel de trabajos previos y una propuesta de mejora para mis contenidos actuales.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40838691, publicado hace 1 hora (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 15 - 25.

opportunities.title: Sports Institute Website Redesign.
opportunities.description: Title: Freelance Website Developer: Redesign & Development for a Sports Business Education Institute (GISB, Mumbai) About us The Global Institute of Sports Business (GISB), Mumbai, is a sports management education institute. We offer postgraduate and professional programmes in sports business, marketing, operations and athlete management. Our website is the main way prospective students find us, learn about our programmes and apply, so we want it to look and work at the level of a top sports organisation. What we need We're looking for an experienced freelance website developer to [redesign our existing website / build a new website] at [current site URL]. The site should be modern, fast, mobile-first and built to turn visitors into applicants. Scope of work Design and develop roughly [X] pages: Home, About, Programmes (individual course pages), Admissions/Apply, Faculty, Placements/Alumni, Events & News/Blog, Contact Fully responsive design (mobile, tablet, desktop) Enquiry and application forms connected to [email / CRM / Google Sheets] Basic on-page SEO: meta tags, page speed, clean URLs, Google Analytics and Search Console setup Integrate social media (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube) and WhatsApp/chat A CMS so our marketing team can update content, blogs and events without coding Brand-consistent UI using our existing brand guidelines (logo, colours, fonts) Handover: admin access, a short walkthrough/training, and basic documentation Required skills Proven experience building websites in [WordPress / Webflow / Shopify / custom (React/Next.js) — confirm with manager] Strong UI/UX sense; Figma experience is a plus HTML, CSS, JavaScript; responsive design SEO basics and site-speed optimisation Experience with education, sports or institutional websites is a big plus.

opportunities.title: 3D CAD Modeling Software Testing
opportunities.description: I need a sharp-eyed tester to put my in-house 3D modeling application through its paces. Your main mission is to stress every step involved in creating and editing models, then push further by building complete assemblies from multiple parts. Import-export routines and basic 2D sketches are outside the scope for now; I want deep, methodical coverage of the core 3D toolset—sketch-to-solid workflows, feature edits, constraints, mating, and assembly validation. You’ll work with the current Windows build, exercise typical mechanical-design scenarios, document any glitches, crashes, or performance bottlenecks, and suggest practical improvements. Please deliver: • A clear, reproducible defect log (screenshots or screen capture welcome) • A concise test report summarising what was covered, notable edge cases, and overall stability impressions • Priority recommendations so my dev team can tackle the most critical issues first Experience with professional CAD platforms such as SolidWorks, Inventor, Fusion 360, or CATIA will help you benchmark expected behaviour and usability standards. Let me know your testing approach and turnaround time so we can get started right away.

opportunities.title: Coordinador de seguridad e infraestructura - SOLO ECUADOR GYE -- 2
opportunities.description: Garantizar la confidencialidad, integridad y disponibilidad (CID) de la información de ICUBE y de sus clientes, liderando la implementación, soporte y mantenimiento del Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información (SGSI – ISO/IEC 27001: International Organization for Standardization / International Electrotechnical Commission), asegurando que la empresa cumpla con estándares internacionales y normativa nacional vigente. --- Funciones Clave 1. Implementar, mantener y mejorar el SGSI (Sistema de Gestión de Seguridad de la Información) en concordancia con ISO/IEC 27001. 2. Identificar y gestionar riesgos de seguridad, desarrollando el Mapa de Riesgos y planes de tratamiento. 3. Administrar y supervisar los controles de acceso, identidades y privilegios (IAM – Identity and Access Management / MFA – Multi-Factor Authentication). 4. Gestionar la detección, análisis y remediación de vulnerabilidades. 5. Implementar y monitorear soluciones de seguridad como: o EDR (Endpoint Detection and Response) o SIEM (Security Information and Event Management) o DLP (Data Loss Prevention) o SOC (Security Operations Center) 6. Definir y aplicar baselines (líneas base de configuración segura) y hardening (endurecimiento de sistemas). 7. Diseñar, ejecutar y validar planes de respaldo y recuperación (DRP – Disaster Recovery Plan / BCP – Business Continuity Plan). 8. Documentar procesos, procedimientos y políticas de seguridad. 9. Capacitar y concienciar a colaboradores en seguridad de la información. 10. Asegurar cumplimiento de la normativa nacional LOPDP (Ley Orgánica de Protección de Datos Personales – Ecuador). 11. Apoyar en auditorías internas y externas de seguridad y certificación. --- Formación Académica: · Ingeniero/a en Sistemas, Informática, Telecomunicaciones o carreras afines. Conocimientos requeridos · Gestión de riesgos y seguridad informática. · Normas: ISO/IEC 27001 (Seguridad de la Información), ISO 22301 (Continuidad del Negocio), LOPDP (Protección de Datos). · Seguridad en entornos cloud (AWS – Amazon Web Services, Azure, Google Cloud Platform). · Arquitectura de redes y firewalls. · Procesos de DRP (Disaster Recovery Plan) y BCP (Business Continuity Plan). · Monitoreo de eventos de seguridad (SIEM, EDR, SOC). Conocimientos complementarios: · Administración de sistemas operativos (Linux). · Virtualización (VMware, Hyper-V, Proxmox). Plataformas · Plataformas en nube (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). · Redes y telecomunicaciones (routing, switching, firewalls). · Bases de datos (MySQL, Postgresql, NoSql). Certificaciones deseables · ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer o Auditor Interno. · CompTIA Security+ (Computing Technology Industry Association Security Plus). · CISSP (Certified Information Systems Security Professional). · CISM (Certified Information Security Manager). · CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker). · ITIL Foundation (Information Technology Infrastructure Library – Gestión de Servicios de TI). Competencias Clave · Pensamiento analítico y gestión de riesgos. · Ética profesional y confidencialidad. · Comunicación efectiva con áreas técnicas y directivas. · Liderazgo en gestión del cambio cultural hacia la seguridad. · Capacidad de respuesta ágil ante incidentes. En Oficina

opportunities.title: Post giornalieri su TikTok, contenuti forniti (residenti in Italia, ~10 min al giorno)
opportunities.description: Cerchiamo 10 freelance Chi siamo Attention Lab è un'agenzia media internazionale che lavora con numerose app rivolte al grande pubblico in tutto il mondo. Cerchiamo persone affidabili per pubblicare su TikTok contenuti in formato slideshow per le app dei nostri clienti. Il lavoro è semplice e adatto anche a chi è alle prime armi: tutti i contenuti vengono forniti già pronti da pubblicare. I contenuti sono adattati al pubblico italiano, quindi cerchiamo solo persone di madrelingua italiana. Il lavoro Ogni giorno il nostro team ti invia caroselli di foto pronti all'uso: immagini, didascalia e audio. Li pubblichi su un nuovo account TikTok che apri sul tuo telefono per questo progetto (non devi mostrare il viso né condividere dati personali). Ti servono circa 10 minuti al giorno. Ogni giorno • Pubblichi 2 caroselli al giorno, tutti i giorni, all'orario che preferisci • Carichi le immagini seguendo la numerazione, incolli la didascalia fornita e scegli il brano indicato • Inserisci il link di ogni post in un foglio condiviso, così possiamo tenere il conto Compenso • Il pagamento è settimanale, tramite Upwork • 12 USD a settimana, dalla prima settimana, per i 14 post (da lunedì a domenica) • Siamo disponibili a continuare con chi pubblica con regolarità e si dimostra affidabile Fa per te se • Vivi in Italia e l'italiano è la tua lingua madre • Usi già TikTok • Pubblichi dal tuo telefono: niente VPN, niente bot • Ti piace la routine (riesci a pubblicare ogni giorno) e curi i dettagli (ordine delle slide, didascalia) Come candidarti Inizia la tua proposta con la parola «carousel», poi indicaci la tua città, il modello del tuo telefono e da quanto tempo usi TikTok. Prima del primo post firmiamo con ogni persona un breve accordo scritto. — ENGLISH VERSION — Daily TikTok posting, content supplied (Italy residents, ~10 min/day) Needs 10 freelancers Who we are Attention Lab is an international media agency working with a large set of consumer apps worldwide. We're looking for reliable people to post TikTok slideshow content for our clients’ apps. The role is simple and available for beginners, as all the content is directly provided and ready to be posted. The content is localized, so we're looking for native speakers only. The job Every day, our team sends you photo carousels that are ready to go: images, caption and sound. You post them on a new TikTok account that you open on your own phone for this project (no need to show your face or share personal details). It takes about 10 minutes a day. Day to day • Post 2 carousels a day, every day, at whatever time suits you • Import the images in their numbered order, paste provided caption and pick the indicated song • Drop the link of each post into a shared sheet so we can count Pay • Payment is made weekly, through Upwork • $12 a week, from week 1, for the 14 posts (Monday to Sunday) • We are willing to carry on with everyone who posts regularly, as long as they are reliable You'll fit if you • Live in Italy and Italian is your first language • Already use TikTok • Post from your own phone: no VPN, no bots • Like a routine (able to post every day) and get the small things right (slide order, caption) How to apply Begin your proposal with the word "carousel", then tell us your city, your phone model and how long you've been on TikTok. We sign a short written agreement with each person before the first post.

opportunities.title: Indeed Employer Account Holder – Job Posting Specialist ($100 Per Job Post)
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced Indeed Job Posting Specialist who already has an active and established Indeed Employer/Recruiter Account. We need a reliable freelancer who can publish job advertisements through their own legitimate Indeed Employer Account and support our high-volume recruitment campaign. Project Objective Our overall recruitment campaign aims to generate approximately 5,000 genuine applicants through Indeed job advertisements. We are looking for someone who can publish and manage job postings effectively to help us achieve this applicant target. Requirements Must have an active Indeed Employer/Recruiter Account. Minimum $10/Day in Indeed advertising spending history or established account standing. Previous experience publishing jobs on Indeed. Account must be in good standing and capable of publishing job advertisements. Experience managing multiple job postings. Ability to support high-volume recruitment campaigns. Scope of Work Publish job advertisements using your Indeed Employer Account. Follow our provided job descriptions and posting requirements. Ensure job advertisements are submitted accurately. Monitor job posting status and publication. Share job posting links and confirmation screenshots. Monitor applicant activity and provide regular updates. Support the overall target of generating approximately 5,000 genuine applicants. Applicant Quality Requirements Applicants must be genuine individuals who voluntarily apply for advertised positions. No fake, bot-generated or duplicate applications. Applications must come through Indeed's standard application process. Applicant volume and progress should be reported regularly. Payment $100 per successfully published, verified job post and share 5k applicants . Payment will be processed through Freelancer.com. Payment will be released after successful publication, verification and share 5k applicants. This is a per-job-post payment arrangement, not a payment-per-applicant arrangement. How to Apply Please answer the following questions: Do you currently have an active Indeed Employer Account? How long have you been using your Indeed account? What is your approximate Indeed advertising spending history? How many job postings have you successfully published? Have you previously managed high-volume applicant campaigns? Can you provide screenshots demonstrating your account status and previous job postings? Important We are specifically looking for freelancers who already own and operate their Indeed Employer Accounts. We are not looking for account creation services, account rentals or account-sharing arrangements. We are interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with reliable Indeed Job Posting Specialists who can support our recruitment requirements.

opportunities.verbatim_request: "We are looking for an experienced Indeed Job Posting Specialist who already has an active and established Indeed Employer/Recruiter Account. We need a reliable freelancer who can publish job advertisements through their own legitimate Indeed Employer Account and support our high-volume recruitment campaign. Project Objective Our overall recruitment campaign aims to generate approximately 5,000 genuine applicants through Indeed job advertisements. We are looking for someone who can publish and manage job postings effectively to help us achieve this applicant target. Requirements Must have an active Indeed Employer/Recruiter Account. Minimum $10/Day in Indeed advertising spending history or established account standing. Previous experience publishing jobs on Indeed. Account must be in good standing and capable of publishing job advertisements. Experience managing multiple job postings. Ability to support high-volume recruitment campaigns. Scope of Work Publish job advertisements using your Indeed Employer Account. Follow our provided job descriptions and posting requirements. Ensure job advertisements are submitted accurately. Monitor job posting status and publication. Share job posting links and confirmation screenshots. Monitor applicant activity and provide regular updates. Support the overall target of generating approximately 5,000 genuine applicants. Applicant Quality Requirements Applicants must be genuine individuals who voluntarily apply for advertised positions. No fake, bot-generated or duplicate applications. Applications must come through Indeed's standard application process. Applicant volume and progress should be reported regularly. Payment $100 per successfully published, verified job post and share 5k applicants . Payment will be processed through Freelancer.com. Payment will be released after successful publication, verification and share 5k applicants. This is a per-job-post payment arrangement, not a payment-per-applicant arrangement. How to Apply Please answer the following questions: Do you currently have an active Indeed Employer Account? How long have you been using your Indeed account? What is your approximate Indeed advertising spending history? How many job postings have you successfully published? Have you previously managed high-volume applicant campaigns? Can you provide screenshots demonstrating your account status and previous job postings? Important We are specifically looking for freelancers who already own and operate their Indeed Employer Accounts. We are not looking for account creation services, account rentals or account-sharing arrangements. We are interested in establishing a long-term working relationship with reliable Indeed Job Posting Specialists who can support our recruitment requirements."

opportunities.title: All-Rounder Digital Business Manager & Growth Specialist for LoanSathi.in
opportunities.description: We are looking for an experienced and multi-skilled Digital Business All-Rounder who can help us manage, improve and grow our complete digital business operations. Company: LoanSathi Website: https://www.loansathi.in/ Industry: Fintech / Loan Assistance Work Type: Freelance / Long-Term Collaboration We need someone who understands different areas of digital business management and can independently handle tasks, identify problems, implement solutions and coordinate with specialist teams whenever required. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. WEBSITE & APP MANAGEMENT - Manage and improve our existing website and Android app. - Fix website issues and improve user experience. - Manage landing pages, enquiry forms and payment flows. - Improve loan EMI and eligibility calculators. - Manage website features and app-related updates. 2. CRM & BUSINESS AUTOMATION - Manage and improve our existing CRM. - Set up automatic lead assignment and follow-up systems. - Manage multiple employees and user permissions. - Track employee performance, calling activity and orders. - Automate daily business processes and reporting. 3. WHATSAPP API & CHATBOT - Manage official WhatsApp Business API integration. - Develop customer onboarding chatbot workflows. - Automate customer replies and follow-ups. - Connect WhatsApp with CRM. - Manage templates, customer communication and human-agent handover. 4. PAYMENT GATEWAY & ORDER MANAGEMENT - Manage payment gateway integrations such as Cashfree, Zaakpay, Instamojo or CCAvenue, where applicable. - Track successful, pending and failed payments. - Manage transaction IDs and payment verification. - Integrate payment status with CRM and website. - Maintain order tracking and payment reports. 5. CALLING SOFTWARE & TELEPHONY - Manage cloud calling and CRM calling integrations. - Understand virtual numbers, DID, GSM/SIM-based calling and calling channels. - Track incoming/outgoing calls and employee talk time. - Coordinate calling software setup and troubleshooting. 6. META ADS & DIGITAL MARKETING - Manage Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns. - Understand audience targeting and campaign optimisation. - Manage Facebook Pixel and Conversion API. - Track leads, purchases, conversions and ROI. - Coordinate retargeting and advertising strategies. 7. GRAPHIC DESIGN, VIDEO & SOCIAL MEDIA - Manage advertising creatives, posters and banners. - Coordinate reels, short videos and promotional content. - Manage social media pages and campaigns. - Create regional marketing campaigns for different Indian states. - Coordinate designers and video editors. 8. SEO & WEBSITE CONTENT - Manage SEO and keyword research. - Improve website content and landing pages. - Coordinate blogs and articles. - Manage local SEO and Google Business Profile activities. - Improve website and app visibility. 9. SALES & CUSTOMER OPERATIONS - Understand the complete customer journey from enquiry to onboarding. - Manage lead follow-ups and customer communication processes. - Coordinate customer calling and payment follow-ups. - Improve sales scripts and customer support workflows. - Manage application status and customer issue tracking. 10. LOAN OPERATIONS & DOCUMENTATION - Understand personal, business, home, education and other loan categories. - Coordinate customer document collection and verification workflows. - Manage application-related follow-ups. - Coordinate with banks and NBFC-related teams. - Improve customer onboarding and service processes. 11. HR & EMPLOYEE MANAGEMENT - Coordinate recruitment and freelancer hiring. - Manage employee onboarding and training processes. - Maintain attendance, targets and performance reports. - Manage calling and order-based incentive tracking. - Develop employee SOPs and team workflows. 12. REPORTING & BUSINESS GROWTH - Prepare daily, weekly and monthly business reports. - Track advertising expenses, orders and revenue. - Monitor employee and department performance. - Identify operational problems and suggest practical solutions. - Coordinate different departments to improve overall productivity. REQUIRED SKILLS - Digital Business Management. - Website & App Management. - CRM & Automation. - WhatsApp Business API. - Payment Gateway Integration. - Meta Ads & Conversion Tracking. - SEO & Social Media. - Basic Graphic Design & Content Management. - Cloud Calling & Telephony Knowledge. - Sales & Operations Management. - HR & Team Coordination. - Problem-Solving & Project Management. WHAT WE EXPECT We are looking for someone who can take responsibility, understand our business requirements, manage different tasks and get actual work completed. You should be comfortable working with multiple software platforms, identifying technical and operational problems, suggesting improvements and coordinating specialists when advanced technical work is required. HOW TO APPLY Please provide: 1. Your experience and professional background. 2. Your portfolio or previous projects. 3. Software, tools and platforms you can manage. 4. Which responsibilities you can handle independently. 5. Your estimated project cost or hourly rate. 6. Your availability for long-term collaboration. IMPORTANT We are not looking for someone who only provides suggestions. We need a practical all-rounder who can manage multiple business activities, execute tasks and help us build an organised and scalable business operation. We prefer a long-term working relationship with the right candidate.

opportunities.title: Build Multi-Platform Publishing Automation
opportunities.description: Complete Job Details (Copy & Paste) Project Summary I am an independent author looking for an experienced social-media automation and publishing systems specialist to build, test, and hand over a complete, semi-automated multi-platform publishing pipeline. This is a one-time fixed-price setup, testing, and handover project. Once the system is built, live-tested, documented, and handed over, the initial contract ends. However, if you do an excellent job on the setup and revenue begins coming in from the projects, I am open to handing ongoing daily operation over to you on separate terms later. 1. The Core Publishing Structure (Substack as Master Source) Substack serves as my single Master Source for three distinct daily content streams: • Morning Stream — The Daily Rant: Daily commentary essay. • Midday Stream — Dire Stress: Science-fiction book visual teaser and chapter/purchase link (Lulu/Substack). • Evening Stream — The Challenge: Non-fiction community project post and discussion prompt. Strict Creative Integrity Rule: • I am the author; you are building the technical pipeline. My original wording, tone, and meaning are never to be rewritten, embellished, or altered without explicit approval. • Platform versions may only perform technical adaptations (shortening to meet platform character limits, adding approved destination links/CTAs, formatting, and resizing media). 2. Target Platforms & Required Connections (All 8 Channels + Medium) You will configure and connect my accounts into Buffer (or an agreed low-cost equivalent scheduler) so each of the three daily streams routes properly: 1. Substack (Master source; connect Substack Notes if supported) 2. Facebook Page (Set up/connect a public author/project Page—not a personal profile—so automated scheduling works; full Daily Rant text where readable, plus teasers/links) 3. Bluesky (Concise excerpts/questions under 300 characters + image/link; thread support if needed) 4. X (Twitter) (Sharp excerpts/questions within 280-character limit + link; thread formatting where needed) 5. Threads (Conversational reflections/teasers within 500-character limit) 6. Pinterest (Vertical pin images for Dire Stress and The Challenge with legible teaser text, title, description, and destination URL to Lulu/Substack) 7. Instagram (Professional/Creator Account) (Teaser images/carousels, Challenge graphics, and Reels) 8. TikTok (9:16 vertical short videos with readable on-screen text and concise captions) 9. YouTube Shorts (9:16 vertical short videos with title, description, and destination link) • Plus Medium Workflow: Set up a clean import/republishing workflow for selected full essays with canonical links pointing back to Substack. Note on Account Ownership: Every account, workspace, and subscription must be registered under my email addresses and 100% administrative ownership from day one. 3. Required Deliverables (All Must Be Completed Before Final Sign-Off) • Deliverable A — Scheduler & Account Setup: All target channels properly connected, authenticated, and organized into clean master folders for each of the three daily streams. • Deliverable B — Platform Adaptation Templates & Batch-Approval Sheet: o Reusable templates for each of the three streams across every connected platform. o A simple, single-view daily or weekly batch-approval sheet showing: (1) the three Substack master posts, (2) adapted platform captions, (3) attached images/videos, (4) exact destination links, (5) scheduled dates/times, and (6) clear flags on any text shortened beyond basic formatting. I want to review and approve batches quickly in one place rather than approving dozens of separate posts one by one. • Deliverable C — 9:16 Short-Video Workflow & 3 Prototypes: o Set up a repeatable template workflow (using Canva Free or an agreed free/low-cost tool) to turn my existing teaser artwork into 9:16 vertical short videos. o Video rules: Place landscape/square artwork cleanly on a vertical layout without cropping out original text; add gentle motion (subtle zoom/pan); keep original text completely readable; add a standard final Call-to-Action end screen (e.g., "Read the first chapter free" + Lulu/Substack link); do not use AI tools that distort faces or alter original artwork. o Produce 3 tested video prototypes (1 Dire Stress teaser, 1 Challenge dilemma, 1 Daily Rant quote/visual) ready for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. • Deliverable D — End-to-End Live Testing: o Run live scheduled test posts across all connected channels to verify that text, images, videos, links, and publishing times execute accurately without errors. • Deliverable E — Plain-English Operating Guide & Full Handover: o Write a clear, step-by-step operating manual in plain, non-technical English (written for a writer, not a developer) explaining how to review/approve batches, check for failed posts, and run the daily routine. o Transfer all logins, passwords, templates, folders, and full administrative ownership to me. 4. How to Apply (Required Information) Please provide a fixed-price quote for the complete setup, testing, guide, and handover described above. Generic copy-paste proposals will not be considered. In your reply, please include: 1. Your Fixed Price for delivering everything listed above (broken into 3 clear escrow milestones: Setup & Templates, Video Workflow & Live Testing, Guide & Handover). 2. Recommended Tool Stack: Which free-tier or minimal-cost tools you recommend (e.g., Buffer + Canva Free) so my ongoing monthly software subscriptions stay as low as possible. 3. Relevant Experience: One brief example of a multi-channel social publishing or short-video automation pipeline you have built and handed over to a client. 4. Confirmation: Confirm that you agree to deliver a plain-English written operating guide and transfer 100% ownership of all accounts and templates before final payment is released.

opportunities.title: WordPress AI Assistant & Image Update
opportunities.description: I want to enhance my WordPress site with a small, smart chat-bubble assistant that can instantly answer visitor questions about our products and services. The bot should pull its knowledge from two places: • the existing pages and posts already live on the site • a short, curated Q&A list I’ll supply Please handle the complete setup—selecting or coding the plugin, connecting it with OpenAI (or a comparable NLP engine), indexing the content sources, styling the chat bubble so it fits our theme, and testing until responses feel natural. Alongside the chatbot work, I need a handful of page images refreshed. I’ll provide the new artwork; you just need to upload, replace, and make sure everything is optimised and displays crisply on desktop and mobile. Deliverables: 1. Fully functioning chat-bubble assistant, live on every page, trained on the sources above 2. Admin guide (one-pager is fine) showing how I can add new Q&As in future 3. Updated images on the specified pages, compressed and retina-ready If you’re comfortable with WordPress, AI chatbot plugins or custom code, and basic media optimisation, this should be a straightforward project. Let me know your timeline and any tool preferences so we can get started right away.

After the animation pass, the same file will flow straight into the edit, so solid sequencing and basic colour-grading skills are essential. Blender’s latest stable release is the tool of record, together with any add-ons you normally rely on (e.g. Asset Browser, Camera-Rig Pro, Animation Layers). Syncing with my storyboard/animatic, you’ll refine timing, block and polish motions, craft sweeping dolly shots, match cuts, and deliver a final 4K render plus an edit-ready EXR sequence. Deliverables • Complete .blend file with organised collections • Final graded 4K movie (ProRes or DNx) • Lossless image sequence for further post • One revision pass after initial review Acceptance criteria: smooth, cinematic camera language; realistic motion, lighting and materials; continuity with provided animatic; renders free of flicker, noise or clipping. If you thrive on storytelling through the lens and can carry a shot from first keyframe to final fade-out, let’s bring this short film to life.

opportunities.title: 3D Virtual Venue Showcase Webapp
opportunities.description: I’m launching a Qatar-based startup and the very first milestone is a browser-based web app where visitors can freely explore a fully interactive 3D venue—think of it as a digital property or museum tour they can walk through from any device. I need an independent developer (not an agency) who can own both the real-time 3D layer and the web stack that wraps around it. Here’s the big picture. Users enter the site, spawn inside a photorealistic space and move around with standard WASD / touch controls. Hotspots reveal extra media or links, and the whole scene must stream smoothly on desktop and mobile. I’m open to whichever engine you’re most comfortable with—Three.js, Babylon.js, WebGL, even Unity or Unreal Web builds—so long as the final experience loads fast, has crisp lighting, and doesn’t overwhelm mid-range devices. To kick things off, I’d like: • A minimal proof-of-concept scene (one venue, basic navigation, 2–3 info hotspots). • A lightweight React or Vue wrapper with a landing page, login placeholder and embedded canvas. • Clean, modular code ready for future features such as multi-user chat or event scheduling. Once the POC is solid, we’ll expand together: additional venues, asset pipelines, maybe VR support. I prefer real-time collaboration—if you can meet in Doha that’s ideal, otherwise a quick Discord call works. Creativity, ambition and the desire for a long-term partnership matter more to me than corporate polish. If crafting immersive 3D spaces excites you, let’s talk and map out the next steps.

opportunities.title: Editor de Reels para Crecer Audiencia
opportunities.description: Estamos buscando un editor de videos talentoso y creativo para producir contenido dinámico y atractivo para nuestras redes sociales. El profesional será responsable de tomar material en bruto proporcionado por nosotros y editarlo según nuestros estándares de calidad y estilo. Además de la edición, esperamos que el freelancer nos asista en la subida de los videos a las plataformas, siguiendo los parámetros acordados, y contribuya activamente con ideas para el crecimiento y el alcance de nuestro contenido. El objetivo principal es expandir la visibilidad de nuestra marca. Nuestros videos son tips sobre temas energéticos/espirituales, o promociones nuestros cursos tanto en ambito presencial (provincia de Malaga, España) como online (sobre esto ultimo, con objetivo de llegar a nuevas audiencias en Latinoamérica y España). También hacemos viajes iniciáticos/espirituales, para los cuales tambien hacemos tanto campañas de mostrar la magia de esos destinos, como promocionar el viaje en si acompañado de nosotros. Buscamos a alguien con experiencia en edición de video para redes sociales, que entienda las tendencias actuales y pueda aportar una visión estratégica para maximizar el impacto de cada publicación. Son clips generalmente hablando a camara bien iluminados, que no requiren de una destreza extrema para editar (hasta ahora lo hemos hecho nosotros, pero necesitamos más regularidad). El objetivo es hacer unas 3-4 publicaciones semanales - Siempre videos cortos de unos 60/90s para Insta/FB y TikTok.

opportunities.title: Edit My YouTube Vlog Videos
opportunities.description: I shoot regular travel-, gaming-, and lifestyle-focused vlogs and need a reliable editor to turn the raw footage into polished YouTube uploads. The look I’m after is clean and simple: tight cuts that keep the story moving, a few well-placed text callouts, and nothing too flashy. Think clear pacing, tidy transitions, and subtle background music when it helps the flow. You’re welcome to work in Premiere Pro, Final Cut, DaVinci Resolve, or any NLE you’re comfortable with, as long as the final render is YouTube-ready and the project file comes along for future tweaks. Typical workflow will be straightforward: I’ll share the footage via Drive, you trim out the dead space, layer in basic text or lower thirds where context is needed, balance the audio, and deliver the finished MP4 plus the editable timeline. If a concise, uncluttered edit style is second nature to you, I’d love to see a sample of similar vlog work and discuss the first video.

opportunities.title: Inviting 2-Bed Floor Plan Upgrade
opportunities.description: I already have a clean one-bedroom floor plan in PDF/DWG and now need it turned into a warm, buyer-friendly sales piece. The plan must grow to two bedrooms, add a swimming pool, and show a refreshed furniture layout that still feels spacious. Please also illustrate the patio, garden strip, parking space, and connecting paths so the whole outdoor story is clear at a glance. The look I want is the kind you see in a real-estate brochure: soft, inviting colours, easy-to-read room labels, and just enough shadow or texture to make the spaces feel real without looking technical. Deliverables • High-resolution, full-colour floor plan (print-ready A4 PDF plus PNG/JPEG) • Editable source file in DWG, AI, or similar format I will provide the current drawing and key dimensions as soon as we start. Keep all measurements accurate while you integrate the new bedroom and pool. Feel free to work in AutoCAD, Revit, SketchUp, Illustrator, or any tool you prefer—accuracy and that warm brochure style are what matter most.

opportunities.title: B2B Meeting Setters for Trackalyst
opportunities.description: I run **Trackalyst**, a field staff tracking and order management app for companies whose sales and service teams work on the ground. It covers live location, GPS distance, visits, orders, expenses, targets and incentives, all on Android with a manager dashboard. We also **customise it to each client's field-level requirements**, and we **digitalise their manual processes**, like approvals, order flows, reports and forms, that still run on paper, WhatsApp or Excel. **What you'll do** - Find companies that have field staff or manual processes, in any industry. - Reach owners, directors or sales heads and pitch the idea. I'll give you a short pitch, a demo video and our website. - **Finalise the meeting** (date, time, online or in person) and share the client's details with me: company name, contact person, role, phone, email, and what they're looking for. **What you earn** - **₹1,000 for every meeting, paid as soon as the meeting happens.** - **₹5,000 to ₹10,000 bonus** when a client you brought signs up, depending on the deal size. You're paid after I receive the client's payment. - No cap. Book as many meetings as you can. **Good fit if you** - Have done B2B sales, telecalling or lead generation before - Can work independently, from anywhere in India **To apply**, DM me a few lines on your sales experience and the industries where you have contacts. Website: trackalyst.netlify.app

opportunities.title: AI Order Processing Automation
opportunities.description: I need an AI-driven agent that sits inside our workflow and, the moment a new order appears in our marketplace-based order-management system, takes care of everything that follows. The agent should read the order payload, generate a correct invoice inside our accounting tool, create the corresponding shipping task or label through the shipping API we already use, and then push a friendly status update back to the customer via the marketplace’s messaging channel or email. The build can be in Python (FastAPI, async) or Node, but it has to be clean, test-covered code that leverages an LLM such as GPT-4 for the conversational pieces. You will connect to the marketplace API, our invoicing endpoint, and ShipStation (or a comparable service) using secure token handling, and you’ll maintain a lightweight Postgres record of every action for traceability. Please include: • A Docker-ready service or AWS Lambda handler that can be triggered by a webhook when a new order arrives • Environment-variable driven configuration for all credentials • Unit tests plus a short README explaining local setup, deployment, and how to extend the agent’s skills The project is complete when I can watch a new marketplace order flow all the way to “shipped” status with an invoice generated and the buyer automatically informed—no manual keystrokes required.

opportunities.title: Hindi Job Promo Copy
opportunities.description: Mujhe ek zabardast social-media post ki zaroorat hai jo Mathura-Vrindavan ke experienced job seekers ko turant attract kare. Main CHIRAG, ACH Private Limited se hoon aur hamari opening — calling, customer handling, training aur management in-charge ke domains mein — un professionals ke liye hai jo apni skills ko next level tak le jaana chahte hain. Post puri tarah Hindi mein hogi, tone energetic aur aspirational rahega. Core hook “skills training & growth” par centered hona chahiye, saath hi best earning potential ka subtle mention bhi aa jaaye. Audience already job hunt par hai, isliye content crisp CTA ke saath draft kijiye jo unhe “abhi message karein” par motivate kare. Deliverable: • Ek ready-to-publish Hindi caption (≈80–120 words) suitable for Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp. • 2–3 attention-grabbing headline options to A/B test. • Hashtag suggestions (5–7 maximum) relevant to Mathura-Vrindavan jobs. Main text, headlines aur hashtags sab ek hi document/file mein share kijiye. Once I’m happy with the wording, project complete.

opportunities.title: Automated Cryptocurrency Trading Bot Development
opportunities.description: I’m looking to have a cryptocurrency trading bot built that can connect to leading exchanges (Binance, Kraken, Coinbase Pro, KuCoin or similar) through their REST / WebSocket APIs, monitor live market data, and place buy or sell orders automatically whenever the predefined strategy’s entry or exit conditions are met. The core of the work is the automation: once parameters are set, the bot should run unattended, handling position sizing, risk limits, and basic error recovery so it can trade 24/7 without intervention. Here’s the flow I have in mind: • Strategy engine – accept simple rule sets (indicators, price action, time filters) that I can edit myself, preferably in a human-readable config or via a small GUI. • Execution layer – handle order placement, cancellation, and position tracking with proper rate-limit management. • Backtesting & live-paper mode – allow me to validate strategies on historical data before switching to real funds. • Reporting – real-time PnL, trade logs, and daily summaries saved locally and optionally pushed to Google Sheets or a lightweight web dashboard. • Security – encrypted API-key storage and two-factor prompt on sensitive actions such as withdrawals. Please send a detailed project proposal outlining: 1. The tech stack you would use (Python + CCXT, Node.js, Go, etc.). 2. How you plan to structure the strategy module and make it extensible. 3. Timeline, milestones, and any past examples that prove you’ve delivered similar crypto bots. Optional features such as push notifications or future copy-trading add-ons are welcome but secondary to getting a solid auto-trader running first. I’ll review proposals that clearly address these points and demonstrate an understanding of exchange API quirks, latency considerations, and risk controls. Looking forward to seeing how you’d approach this build.

opportunities.title: UE5 MetaHuman Pipeline Specialist
opportunities.description: I’m building a proof-of-concept inside Unreal Engine 5.4+ that relies on MetaHuman characters. For the initial POC I only need medium-fidelity results that play smoothly in-editor; once approved, the same assets must be pushed to full cinematic quality for a final showcase render. I need a technical artist who understands the entire MetaHuman pipeline—customising the digital humans, bringing them into Unreal with hair, clothing and materials intact, then setting up facial and body animation so everything survives the jump to movie-ready output. You’ll be troubleshooting groom and cloth physics, refining shaders, lighting and Lumen settings, and keeping performance in check before switching the project to a high-end, ray-traced pass for sequencer. Relevant tools you should already be comfortable with include Control Rig, Live Link Face / ARKit blend-shapes, groom asset workflows, and Unreal’s Sequencer and Movie Render Queue. Deliverables • A working POC (.uproject) featuring the MetaHuman at medium fidelity, running in real time with correct materials, hair and wardrobe • A final sequencer scene that renders a 4 K, 24 fps cinematic of the same character(s) with animated facial and body performance • A concise hand-off document explaining each pipeline step and any custom Blueprints or tools used Acceptance criteria • No shader, groom or physics errors on load • Facial motion aligns to supplied reference within 1–2 frames • Final render shows no clipping, light leaks or texture pops If you’ve delivered similar MetaHuman or virtual-production shots before, let me know what you tackled and how long it took—then we can lock in dates and get started.

opportunities.title: Desain AutoCAD Tower BTS
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan untuk mengedit sekaligus merancang gambar AutoCAD untuk sebuah tower telekomunikasi/BTS. File dasar sudah tersedia; saya perlu disesuaikan sesuai spesifikasi terbaru—termasuk ketinggian, detail sambungan, dan tata letak peralatan. Yang saya cari • Freelancer berpengalaman menangani proyek tower telekomunikasi/BTS • Mampu bekerja langsung di format DWG dan tetap menjaga layer, dimension style, serta standar drawing yang berlaku • Terbiasa memeriksa kembali kekuatan struktur, bolt schedule, dan detail base plate Ruang lingkup pekerjaan 1. Memperbarui gambar existing (layout, elevasi, dan detail connection). 2. Menambahkan komponen baru yang sudah saya sediakan dalam sketsa PDF. 3. Menyiapkan output final berupa file DWG siap dicetak dan PDF A3 untuk peninjauan. Kriteria sukses – Semua revisi tercermin akurat di setiap tampilan (plan, section, detail). – Tidak ada error saat file dibuka pada AutoCAD 2020 ke atas. – Struktur layer dan penamaan blok tetap rapi. Sertakan dalam lamaran ringkasan pengalaman relevan Anda dengan proyek tower BTS; portofolio singkat akan sangat membantu saya menilai kecocokan. Terima kasih!

opportunities.title: Rendu 3D Maison Contemporaine en L
opportunities.description: Photographie architecturale ultra réaliste, maison contemporaine compacte construite exactement selon un plan en L de 8,90 m x 9,25 m. Vue 3/4 avant droite en plein jour pour montrer parfaitement la géométrie du projet. À gauche, grande cour/patio ouverte occupant presque la moitié de la largeur totale du bâtiment, sol en dallage clair. L'entrée principale est située dans le renfoncement intérieur du patio et n'est pas visible directement depuis la rue. À droite, volume principal du séjour avec une seule baie vitrée de 2,40 m de large exactement, centrée sur le mur du séjour, sans agrandissement. Derrière le séjour, second volume contenant les chambres. Architecture très fidèle au plan, forme en L clairement lisible, toiture 4 pans anthracite uniquement sur les parties construites, patio totalement ouvert au ciel. Façades enduit beige sable clair, quelques touches discrètes de bois naturel. Menuiseries aluminium noir mat. Dimensions modestes et réalistes d'une maison d'environ 80 m² habitables. Ambiance chaleureuse mais économique à construire. Pelouse simple, quelques plantes en pots. Aucun garage, aucune voiture, aucune personne. Rendu photoréaliste d'architecte, proportions exactes, pas de villa luxueuse, pas d'ouvertures supplémentaires, pas de porte sur la façade avant. opportunities.title: AI Telegram FAQ Chatbot
opportunities.description: I need an AI-powered Telegram chatbot that can handle the everyday questions my customers ask. Its primary job is to read the information already published on my website and refer to an internal Q&A document I will supply, then return clear, friendly answers inside Telegram. When the bot cannot find a confident match, it must immediately tell the user how to reach a live support person so no one feels stranded. There is no need for order processing or data capture—just accurate, helpful responses and a smooth hand-off path. Here’s the flow I expect: • The bot receives a question in any common wording. • It searches the indexed website pages and the provided Q&A file to identify the best answer. • If confidence is high, it replies in natural language; if not, it shows our support contact details. Please build, test, and hand over: 1. Source code (Python or Node.js using Telegram Bot API, OpenAI, or similar NLP libraries—whichever you prefer) 2. Instructions for deploying on my server (Docker or simple VPS setup is fine) 3. A short guide so I can update website links or replace the Q&A file whenever content changes Once the bot is live and responding reliably, the project is complete.

opportunities.title: Industrial Inspection Camera Lift/drop
opportunities.description: Needed a compact, motor-driven lift that can raise and lower an inspection camera inside a harsh industrial zone. The mechanism must operate reliably where airborne particles settle on everything, high-pressure water jets are used for wash-downs, and occasional heat or chemical vapor bursts are common. Selected environmental challenges • Dust, dirt, or water spray • Heat (65C), chemicals, or corrosive fumes More technical details in attached file. Key expectations The job covers the full mechatronic design: mechanical structure, motor/gear selection, sensors, control electronics, and enclosure sealing strategy. All components have to meet or exceed relevant IP/IK ratings and temperature/chemical resilience so the unit keeps functioning without frequent maintenance. A vibration-free travel path is critical for clear imaging as 2 locations have to be at same spots, else highly undesirable recalibration of camera will be required. An anti-tempering device is desired for enclosure. Deliverables • 3-D CAD files and manufacturing drawings • Control schematic with parts list (RPi5 microcontroller as motion controller with AI llm hat+2. If you prefer anything else, get our approval after justifying) • Step-by-step assembly and maintenance guide • Validation plan outlining how the design will be tested for our requirements Any software tools used will be included in your bid & will become our sole property (with the rest of the solution) with no encumbrances or strings attached. Use of subscription services is discouraged. The budget given is placeholder only, your bid must be final with amount & delivery time. No upfront. A 1st milestone will be created after a acceptable remote demo is shown. 50% payment for milestone 1 after acceptable solution is delivered. 25% after job done. Final 25% payment will be after system delivery is with us for 2 months evaluation without any issues. Payment made only after all source code & support docs are delivered to us & approved for that milestone. Respond only after reading full JD. Submit questions, changes, ideas with 1st response only. No changes allowed to your response till after award acceptance. The person responding will be the person doing the job. Any submissions must be done after full testing by you. Include items not tested & known issues. Only 1 testing session will be done by us before a final test by our team. Do not use any AI or BOT assistance in your communications with us. Those will be treated as fake, go in your disfavor & action taken. Please save yours & our time - do not bid, if you do not like our terms.

opportunities.title: AI Software Cold Caller & Setter
opportunities.description: We are looking for a confident and reliable cold caller to help grow our AI and software engineering business, DiamondDev. We are building a network of technical professionals focused on AI solutions, software development, intelligent automation and AI training services. We are looking for someone who enjoys communicating with people, building business relationships and discovering new commercial opportunities. Responsibilities: - Contact potential business clients by phone. - Introduce our company and technology services. - Identify potential clients' business and technical needs. - Build positive relationships with decision-makers. - Schedule meetings with interested prospects. - Follow up with potential clients. - Maintain records of calls and business opportunities. Requirements: - Fluent and natural English communication. - Experience in cold calling, telemarketing or B2B sales. - Friendly, confident and professional personality. - Ability to communicate without sounding scripted. - Reliable internet connection and a quiet working environment. - Experience in the technology or software industry is a plus. We are particularly interested in professionals familiar with the US and Canadian markets. We will start with a small paid pilot project. If we work well together, we would like to establish a long-term relationship with recurring paid assignments and potential performance-based bonuses. When applying, please share your previous calling experience, availability, hourly rate and the types of businesses you have worked with. We look forward to finding someone who wants to grow with us.

opportunities.title: Automated Appointment Booking Software
opportunities.description: Project Title: Web Automation Software for Automatic Appointment Booking Project Description: I am looking for an experienced Web Developer or Automation Specialist to develop a custom software solution that automates the appointment booking process on a specific website. The main goal is to create a reliable and user-friendly automation tool that can: - Automatically monitor appointment availability on the website. - Detect newly available appointment slots. - Automatically book an appointment based on predefined preferences. - Fill in the required information accurately. - Notify the user when an appointment is successfully booked. - Provide a simple dashboard to manage the automation settings. Requirements: - Experience with Python, JavaScript, or browser automation tools such as Playwright or Selenium. - Strong knowledge of web development and automation. - Ability to build secure and reliable software. - Experience working with appointment booking systems. The software must respect the target website's terms of service, security measures, and booking rules. I'm looking for a serious and experienced developer who can deliver a reliable solution. Please contact me with your experience, estimated timeline, and price.

opportunities.title: Google Scrape: Indian Kurti Retailers
opportunities.description: I need a clean, up-to-date spreadsheet of women’s clothing shops across India that are likely to stock kurtis. Please pull the data directly from Google Search and Google Maps (any method you prefer—Python with BeautifulSoup/Scrapy, Selenium, Apify, etc.—as long as results are accurate and de-duplicated). Group every entry first by State and then by City. For each shop capture both sets of details I selected: • Shop name, phone number, and full address • Shop name, contact person, and WhatsApp number (if listed) Include every women’s apparel outlet that may sell kurtis—boutiques, multi-brand stores, and mixed-category shops are all welcome, not only pure kurti specialists. Deliverables 1. CSV or Google Sheet with one row per shop, columns clearly labelled. 2. A brief note on the scraping approach you used so I can replicate or update the list later. I plan to use this list to build a retailer network, so completeness and accuracy matter more than sheer volume. I’ll review a small sample first; once that’s approved, you can scale to the full dataset.

opportunities.title: Animación Ninja 2D de 30s
opportunities.description: Tengo el diseño estático de un pequeño ninja y necesito darle vida en una animación 2D de unos 30 segundos usando Adobe After Effects. Historia y tono • El corto mostrará al ninja en un entrenamiento dinámico con un estilo caricatura, colorido y simple que combine con el arte que ya tengo. • Quiero ver al personaje caminar, correr, saltar y practicar varios golpes y patadas. • Al final, debe superar su última prueba y, como recompensa, obtener la espada poderosa. Alcance técnico – Anima brazos, piernas, pies y torso para lograr movimientos fluidos y expresivos. – Pueden utilizarse uno o dos escenarios sencillos; bastan fondos limpios que apoyen la narrativa. – Integra transiciones básicas, efectos ligeros de polvo o destellos cuando obtenga la espada, siempre manteniendo el estilo caricatura. – Trabaja todo el proyecto en After Effects; necesitaré tanto el archivo .aep organizado por capas como la exportación final (H.264/MP4 a 1080p). Entregables 1. Animación final de 30 s (MP4). 2. Proyecto de After Effects con todos los assets vinculados. Busco una solución clara y entretenida que cumpla la historia; no requiero composiciones complejas ni efectos 3D. Si necesitas más detalles sobre el personaje o referencias visuales, te facilito la ilustración original de inmediato.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40837900, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: AI Founder Reels Creation
opportunities.description: I will give you studio-quality reference footage, clean voice recordings, brand assets, and full rights to recreate our founder on screen. Your job is to turn that material into a lifelike AI presenter who speaks fluent Hindi and Hinglish, then package each performance into a 30–60 second vertical reel that feels perfectly native to Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and WhatsApp Status. The goal is simple: build trust with our audience by sharing quick founder tips and insights in a way that looks and sounds as if he recorded the content himself. Natural lip-sync, realistic eye blinks, slight head movement, and speech that flows without robotic pauses are non-negotiable. I’m comfortable with proven tools such as Synthesia, HeyGen, D-ID, or your equivalent AI pipeline, provided the final output is crisp 1080 × 1920 and free of uncanny artefacts. Each reel should arrive fully polished: dynamic on-screen captions, light B-roll, subtle zoom cuts, balanced background music, and our on-brand colour palette. Timing matters, too—I need one completed, ready-to-post reel every week. Deliverables (per week) • Script adaptation from my supplied outline (≈90–120 words) • AI-generated video of the founder, rendered in 1080 × 1920, 30–60 seconds • Social edit with captions, graphics, music, and final colour grade • Source project file (Premiere Pro, Final Cut, or DaVinci Resolve) plus exported .mp4 Acceptance criteria • Lifelike Hindi/Hinglish delivery with smooth lip-sync and natural pacing • No jarring cuts, frozen frames, or abrupt audio transitions • Visuals remain sharp and noise-free on mobile playback • Asset hand-off meets Friday 18:00 IST each week If you have a proven reel or two demonstrating similar work, share it, and let’s keep this content pipeline rolling.

opportunities.title: Ventas Gabriel
opportunities.description: Trabajo día a día con un flujo constante de prospectos que llegan a mi WhatsApp interesados en mis servicios profesionales. Mi meta es simple: transformar más de esas conversaciones en ventas cerradas y aumentar los ingresos del negocio. Necesito a un closer que se adueñe del chat, usando exclusivamente mensajes de texto. Sin audios ni llamadas, la comunicación debe ser escrita, ágil y persuasiva. Valoro una redacción impecable en español, dominio de técnicas de cierre consultivo y la habilidad de leer rápidamente las objeciones del cliente para responder con argumentos claros que impulsen la decisión de compra. Qué espero recibir: • Desarrollo y afinado de guiones de texto basados en la oferta actual. • Gestión diaria del pipeline en WhatsApp: seguimiento, recordatorios y cierres. • Reporte breve al finalizar la jornada con número de conversaciones atendidas, cierres logrados y oportunidades pendientes. Considero el trabajo exitoso cuando se nota un incremento tangible en la tasa de conversión y el volumen de ventas por este canal. Si ya tienes experiencia cerrando servicios vía chat y puedes empezar de inmediato, hablemos.

opportunities.title: Diseño Integral de Marca: Logo, Web y Edición de Video para Nueva M...
opportunities.description: Estamos desarrollando una nueva marca colombiana enfocada en promover productos locales y conectar con los consumidores mediante una identidad moderna, auténtica y creativa. Buscamos profesionales creativos e independientes para colaborar en el diseño de logo, desarrollo web y edición de video. Requerimos tres especialistas, uno por cada área: 1. Diseñador Gráfico y de Logotipos: Creación de un logotipo original desde cero, desarrollo de la identidad visual completa, incluyendo paleta de colores, tipografías y materiales gráficos esenciales. Se requiere un portafolio que demuestre logotipos originales y proyectos de identidad visual desarrollados personalmente. 2. Diseñador Web ui/ux: conceptualización y diseño de un sitio web completamente nuevo desde cero. Esto incluye la definición de la estructura, navegación intuitiva, optimización de la experiencia de usuario (UX) y un diseño responsive que garantice la accesibilidad en todos los dispositivos. Buscamos propuestas creativas y originales, no adaptaciones de plantillas. Se requiere un portafolio con diseños web propios, sitios publicados o prototipos en Figma. 3. Editor de Video: Edición de videos promocionales, creación de contenido dinámico para redes sociales, animaciones y piezas audiovisuales destinadas a campañas digitales. Se requiere un portafolio con enlaces directos a videos editados personalmente. Modalidad de Trabajo: El trabajo será remoto, a tiempo parcial y con horarios flexibles, ofreciendo la posibilidad de una colaboración a largo plazo. La tarifa por hora se acordará individualmente según la experiencia y la calidad del portafolio del profesional. Valoramos la creatividad, la autonomía, la iniciativa y la capacidad de aportar ideas originales. Para postularte, por favor incluye: - La especialidad a la que aplicas. - Un portafolio auténtico y específico de tu especialidad. - Una breve descripción de tu experiencia. - Tu disponibilidad semanal. - Tu tarifa por hora en USD. Es indispensable que los trabajos presentados sean propios o que puedas demostrar tu participación directa en ellos. No se considerarán propuestas genéricas o sin un portafolio relevante. opportunities.title: Cotización: síntesis de mi voz desde cero con grabaciones propias
opportunities.description: Busco especialista en síntesis de voz e IA para evaluar y cotizar un programa propio que genere voz a partir de texto usando exclusivamente mis grabaciones originales, con mi consentimiento. Requisito indispensable: entrenar el modelo de síntesis desde cero, sin modelos ni checkpoints de voz preentrenados, voces de terceros, datasets de otras personas ni audio sintético. No busco adaptar una voz existente. Si este enfoque no es viable con los recursos disponibles, necesito una explicación clara antes de contratar. Por ahora estoy recopilando propuestas técnicas generales y cotizaciones para comparar enfoques. No solicito una implementación gratuita ni código de prueba en la postulación. Incluye en tu propuesta: - Experiencia comprobable en TTS y entrenamiento de voz desde cero. - Enfoque técnico general, herramientas, licencias y dependencias, indicando cualquier componente preentrenado y su función. - Cantidad y calidad de grabaciones necesarias, preparación y transcripción del material. - Hardware y tiempo estimados de entrenamiento, costos de desarrollo y operación. - Cómo evaluarías inteligibilidad, naturalidad y semejanza con mi voz. - Entregables propuestos: código fuente, modelo entrenado, documentación e instrucciones de ejecución local. - Plazo, precio y moneda, con supuestos y limitaciones. Los audios y modelos deberán mantenerse privados y no reutilizarse para otros clientes ni entrenamientos. No compartiré grabaciones en la publicación pública. Esta solicitud es para evaluar opciones; cualquier contratación, alcance final y pago se acordarán después.
